prompts.NA:

It has clipped top corners, a punched eyelet, a dark slate outline, and a simple readable handwritten "$8" matching the card's existing price. The tag should be about 15–18% of the bowl's width, large enough to see on a shirt but subordinate to the bowl. Preserve the central bowl silhouette and most of its blue/rust stripes. Match the original restrained engraved/vintage illustration style.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE as closely as possible: the bowl's exact size and placement, old worn ceramic character, existing colors and shading; exact frame, rules, typography, letter shapes, all text and punctuation, spacing and canvas proportions. Do not change the words, add another header, add a scene, or redraw the composition. Original text remains PRICE: $8 / SENTIMENTAL VALUE: / PLEASE DON'T / TELL THE SELLER. Keep the background fully transparent and the actual artwork opaque. No glow, mockup, shirt or extra border.
